name: Crab and loofah soup
summary: Canh rạm mướp is the soup Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, names when the table skips the seafood soups. The greens are rau đay or mùng tơi, with salted cà pháo in shrimp paste, and fried one-sun mackerel for the rice.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015.
howToEat: Crab and loofah, with rau đay or mùng tơi. Cà pháo muối mắm tôm is the side. Cá thu một nắng rán is the salty plate with the rice, not part of the soup.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The ordinary meal, as the alternative soup. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Canh ram muop — crab and loofah in Ha Long
seoDescription: Canh rạm mướp, with rau đay or mùng tơi and salted cà pháo, is the alternative soup in the 2015 Hạ Long meal. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
